title: How I Made My Own iPhone - in China
summary: Strange Parts builds a working refurbished iPhone 6S entirely from components bought in the Huaqiangbei phone parts markets in Shenzhen. The video explains how the markets work and what the parts cost.
why: HN cites it as proof that a full iPhone can be assembled from sourced parts, in right-to-repair and Shenzhen hardware ecosystem discussions.

quote.text: You may enjoy this video where a guy goes to Shenzen and tries to build an iPhone 6s from parts.
